verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt at docs.attio.com that indexes Markdown versions of the docs pages, which are served as .md URLs throughout. The App SDK also ships agent-oriented AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files in every new app, and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 document is published. missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.attio.com/llms.txt # Attio Docs
Every new app comes bootstrapped with a default AGENTS.md file. We additionally supply a CLAUDE.md file to provide instructions for Claude Code users.
The App SDK was designed from the ground up to enable AI-assisted development.
api.attio.com/openapi/api serves the machine-readable OpenAPI document
